summary: Allow one explicit bounded selection to import several inert email attachments through the existing immutable upload pipeline.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better Email efficiency and adaptability
The user previously requested reducing manual imports
Current UI/API reparses and imports every email attachment one at a time
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued efficiency and adaptability improvements across Email content and prior instructions authorize reducing manual imports.
known_limitations: The batch contains only explicitly selected attachments from one already uploaded email and is capped at 100 selections.
Nested messages and their attachments still require another explicit review and import action.
All identities are prevalidated before upload creation, but a later capacity, filesystem or write failure can still leave earlier completed imports visible and the failed upload aborted.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer email, mailbox, provider or paid model is used.
